title: Kiosk Home and Scan Starts
eyebrow: WisconsinKiosk · redesign A3, A6, B1, B2
lede: Home groups game-day gear under its event, and every flow that starts from a scan or someone else's checkout now shows what it is about on the left while asking who you are on the right.

sections.heading: Side by side
sections.note: Before is HEAD 7c3c1fba built separately; after is the same revision plus this slice. Same created iPad Air 11-inch (M4) simulator, iOS 26.5, dark, same GT_KIOSK_SCENARIO fixtures.

pairs.title: A6 · Returning someone's gear
pairs.beforeCap: A sentence about whose gear it is above a plain roster; the owner is one tile among 22.
pairs.afterCap: The checkout (due time, ref, items) on the left; the owner first, then a Someone else grid without them.

pairs.title: Home, ordinary day (no regression)
pairs.beforeCap: Sectioned home from the earlier slice.
pairs.afterCap: Unchanged when no booking is linked to a today event.

sections.heading: After only (new states)
sections.note: These scenarios did not exist before this slice, so the old build cannot render them. Files: after/home-game-day.png, after/identity-scan-free.png, after/identity-scan-reserved.png.

shots.title: A3 game day
shots.cap: A3 · home-game-day: Football vs Iowa with 3 pickups, 3 out and Crew without gear (call times); Volleyball with 2 out; Overdue and Out, due later below.

shots.title: B1 free gear

shots.title: B2 reserved gear
shots.cap: B2 · identity-scan-reserved: Reserved for Erik R., a single Continue as Erik card, and the put-it-back line.

changes.was: Event-linked gear was mixed into Overdue / Due today / Pickup sections with no sign of which game it was for or who on the crew had nothing yet.
changes.now: Each event today with linked pickups, gear out, or crew without gear gets its own card at the top: pickups first, then gear out by person, then a Crew without gear line with call times from the event's assignments. Unlinked bookings fall through to the usual sections.

changes.was: A heading and a sentence, then the whole roster.
changes.now: Booking card on the left (due line, title, owner · ref · count, unreturned items, the 'anyone can bring this back' note, Close); owner card first, then Someone else.

changes.was: Plain roster titled 'Checking out' with no sign of what was scanned.
changes.now: Just scanned card with Available, Free until (next claim, 'then reserved') and Last back from scan-lookup; 'Who's taking it?' roster. 'Where: Shelf B2' dropped (no data).

changes.was: A one-tile roster with 'Confirm Erik Role to continue — tap their name.'
changes.now: Reserved-for card with reservation, pickup time and due back; a single 'Continue as Erik' card and 'Not for Erik? Put it back on the shelf; it's held for their pickup.'
